author: Bobby Grayson
description: Untimed timers over-approximate: the model admits a timeout firing after a pong. The real system under-fires when the mailbox is busy. Safety proofs hold in both; liveness of the watchdog (a hung worker is eventually replaced) would need the timer to actually fire, i.e. a fairness assumption on timers plus quiet mailboxes.
title: BEAM subtlety the untimed model hides: any message resets a GenServer timeout, including :sys.get_state polls. The driver never saw the timeout until it stopped polling. In the model a timeout may fire regardless, which is the safe direction
